title: Voxel art style, 3D cubic block construction, MagicaVoxel aesthetic. Cinematic…
content: Voxel art style, 3D cubic block construction, MagicaVoxel aesthetic. Cinematic game-cutscene presentation with detailed cubic geometry, visible individual voxel units, stylized Minecraft-inspired proportions, physically believable object interactions, and consistent terrain construction. Every character, object, plant, rock, building, and environment element is made entirely from discrete cubic blocks.

es.content:
Estilo de arte voxel, construcción 3D de bloques cúbicos, estética MagicaVoxel. Presentación cinematográfica de cinemática de videojuego con geometría cúbica detallada, unidades voxel individuales visibles, proporciones estilizadas inspiradas en Minecraft, interacciones físicas creíbles entre objetos y construcción coherente del terreno. Cada personaje, objeto, planta, roca, edificio y elemento del entorno está hecho por completo de bloques cúbicos discretos.

--- CONTINUACIÓN DEL HILO ---
[Thread 1] Prompt: Voxel art style, 3D cubic block construction, MagicaVoxel aesthetic. Cinematic game-cutscene presentation with detailed cubic geometry, visible individual voxel units, stylized Minecraft-inspired proportions, physically believable object interactions, and consistent terrain construction. Every character, object, plant, rock, building, and environment element is made entirely from discrete cubic blocks."

visual_feel: "Aventura voxel cinematográfica y caprichosa con luz cálida de amanecer, suave ambient occlusion entre las juntas de los bloques, sutiles rayos volumétricos, terreno herboso detallado, gran profundidad de bosque, cambios dramáticos de elevación, poca profundidad de campo en los planos cercanos y siluetas claras y legibles. El mundo debe sentirse como un entorno físico de videojuego en miniatura, donde la gravedad, las pendientes, el impulso y las colisiones se comportan de forma coherente."

duration: "30 seconds"

aspect_ratio: "16:9"

character_modeling:
chicken:
base: "Pequeña gallina voxel redonda construida por completo con bloques cúbicos robustos, con un cuerpo compacto y redondeado creado a partir de grupos de voxels visibles."
features: "Plumaje blanco y crema en bloques, cresta roja voxel angulosa, pico naranja cúbico, patas cortas de cubo, diminutos pies voxel amarillos y simples ojos oscuros de cubo."
personality: "Tierna, curiosa, confundida por el misterioso huevo y luego decidida y ligeramente asustada cuando el huevo empieza a rodar."
physics: "La gallina tiene un peso creíble para su pequeño tamaño. Los pies permanecen apoyados en el terreno al estar quieta, el cuerpo se desplaza ligeramente al empujar y correr produce pasos escalonados discretos con transferencia de peso visible."
movement: "Todo el movimiento usa animación voxel escalonada. La gallina despierta, camina, inspecciona el huevo, lo toca, lo empuja, se inclina con más fuerza contra él, reacciona cuando empieza a moverse y luego corre cuesta abajo tras él."
continuity: "Exactamente el mismo diseño de gallina, proporciones, colores, rasgos faciales, cresta, pico, pies y construcción voxel durante todo el video."
golden_egg:
base: "Enorme huevo voxel dorado significativamente más grande que la gallina, construido con bloques densos dorados y amarillo pálido."
proportions: "El huevo mide aproximadamente tres veces la altura de la gallina y es lo bastante ancho como para que la gallina no pueda levantarlo."
surface: "Claramente con forma de huevo mediante geometría voxel escalonada, pero aún visiblemente construido con bloques cúbicos. Superficie voxel ligeramente irregular y artesanal."
physics: "El huevo es pesado y permanece inmóvil sobre terreno plano o suavemente inclinado hasta que la gallina aplica suficiente fuerza. Una vez empujado más allá de su punto de equilibrio en la ladera, la gravedad hace que ruede cuesta abajo de forma natural. Acelera gradualmente con la pendiente, mantiene el impulso en el terreno descendente, se ralentiza un poco al llegar a una zona más plana y luego continúa hacia delante hasta el punto final de detención."
continuity: "El huevo debe conservar el mismo tamaño, forma, color, masa y orientación durante toda la secuencia."
critical_behavior: "El huevo nunca flota, se teletransporta, rebota de forma irreal, cambia de dirección sin un obstáculo, rueda cuesta arriba ni se mueve sin causa física."
baby_chicken:
base: "Pequeño y adorable pollito voxel que emerge desde dentro del huevo dorado agrietado."
features: "Cuerpo pequeño de cubos amarillo pálido, diminuto pico naranja, pequeños ojos oscuros de cubo, patitas naranjas en miniatura y proporciones voxel suaves y redondeadas."
personality: "Curioso, inocente, somnoliento e inmediatamente adorable."
movement: "Al principio permanece acurrucado dentro del huevo, luego asoma lentamente la cabeza por la grieta y mira hacia la gallina más grande."
environment_modeling:
hillside_coop:
base: "Pequeño gallinero voxel de madera situado claramente en la parte superior de una ladera herbosa."
features: "Paredes de tablones de madera construidas con cubos apilados, entrada cuadrada, pequeño nido de paja, techo sencillo, secciones cortas de valla y bloques de hierba dispersos."
terrain: "El gallinero se encuentra sobre una pendiente herbosa visiblemente elevada. El terreno justo fuera de la puerta desciende continuamente cuesta abajo."
spatial_logic: "El gallinero es el punto más alto de la secuencia. La colina desciende alejándose del gallinero en una dirección clara, creando la ruta natural para que ruede el huevo."
downhill_meadow:
base: "Ladera voxel abierta y herbosa directamente debajo del gallinero."
features: "Bloques de hierba y tierra en capas, pequeñas flores, piedras dispersas, pequeños grupos de hierba y terreno suavemente irregular."
spatial_logic: "El prado forma una pendiente continua cuesta abajo. No hay barreras invisibles ni cambios de elevación sin explicación."
forest_path:
base: "Un camino voxel mayormente recto y más plano que continúa desde la base de la colina herbosa."
features: "Árboles cúbicos densos a ambos lados, follaje cúbico verde oscuro, troncos voxel gruesos, arbustos, piedras y parches de hierba."
spatial_logic: "El bosque existe a ambos lados del camino, pero no bloquea la ruta del huevo. El camino avanza recto y se estrecha gradualmente hacia el borde del río."
river:
base: "Río voxel profundo y ancho situado más allá del final del camino del bosque."
features: "Agua cúbica en capas de azul oscuro, riberas escarpadas y bloqueadas, profundidad visible por debajo del camino y rocas dispersas a lo largo del agua."
spatial_logic: "El río se encuentra significativamente por debajo del camino en el borde final, creando una caída peligrosa. El huevo se acerca directamente al borde y caería al río si la gallina no lo detuviera."
final_edge:
base: "Un claro borde de acantilado en bloques donde termina el camino recto del bosque sobre el río profundo."
features: "Bloques de hierba que terminan bruscamente, algunos bloques expuestos de tierra y piedra, agua visible muy abajo."
physics: "El huevo sigue rodando hacia el borde, pero la gallina lo detiene físicamente antes de que su centro de masa cruce el límite del acantilado."

cinematic_storyboard:
00_04_waking_and_discovery:
camera: "Plano medio interior dentro del gallinero elevado. Comenzar enfocado en la gallina durmiendo en su nido de paja y luego hacer un suave travelling hacia la puerta cuadrada."
action: "La gallina despierta con dos lentos movimientos escalonados. Parpadea, se estira ligeramente, sale del nido y camina bamboleándose hacia la puerta. Al salir, se detiene de repente."
reveal: "La cámara se mueve detrás de la gallina y revela un gigantesco huevo voxel dorado situado a varios pasos de distancia sobre la ladera herbosa."
performance: "La gallina inclina la cabeza a la izquierda y luego a la derecha, claramente confundida."
lighting: "Suave luz dorada de amanecer entrando por la puerta, con una luz más brillante en el exterior."
audio: "Ambiente matinal tranquilo, pequeños pasos, pájaros lejanos, sutil tono mágico cuando se revela el huevo dorado."
04_08_inspection:
camera: "Ángulo bajo en tres cuartos mostrando tanto a la gallina como al huevo gigante sobre el terreno inclinado."
action: "La gallina camina lentamente alrededor del huevo, mirándolo hacia arriba. Se acerca al lado inferior del huevo y lo toca suavemente con un ala."
reaction: "El huevo no se mueve. La gallina espera, parpadea y luego lo toca otra vez."
physical_detail: "Los pies de la gallina permanecen firmemente apoyados en la ladera. El huevo sigue completamente inmóvil."
performance: "La gallina se vuelve más curiosa y apoya ambas alas contra el huevo."
audio: "Suaves sonidos de golpecitos contra la dura cáscara voxel, ambiente matinal tranquilo."
08_12_the_push:
camera: "Perfil lateral a ras de suelo, mostrando claramente la dirección cuesta abajo de la colina herbosa."
action: "La gallina se inclina hacia delante y empuja el huevo con el cuerpo. Al principio el huevo apenas se mueve. La gallina desliza ligeramente los pies hacia atrás bajo presión y luego emp

fr.content:
Style art voxel, construction en blocs cubiques 3D, esthétique MagicaVoxel. Présentation cinématographique de type cinématique de jeu avec géométrie cubique détaillée, unités voxel individuelles visibles, proportions stylisées inspirées de Minecraft, interactions d’objets physiquement crédibles et construction du terrain cohérente. Chaque personnage, objet, plante, roche, bâtiment et élément de l’environnement est entièrement composé de blocs cubiques discrets.

--- CONTINUATION DU FIL ---
[Thread 1] Prompt: Style art voxel, construction en blocs cubiques 3D, esthétique MagicaVoxel. Présentation cinématographique de type cinématique de jeu avec géométrie cubique détaillée, unités voxel individuelles visibles, proportions stylisées inspirées de Minecraft, interactions d’objets physiquement crédibles et construction du terrain cohérente. Chaque personnage, objet, plante, roche, bâtiment et élément de l’environnement est entièrement composé de blocs cubiques discrets."

visual_feel: "Aventure voxel cinématique et fantaisiste avec une lumière chaude de lever de soleil, un occlusion ambiante douce entre les joints des blocs, de subtils rayons volumétriques, un terrain herbeux détaillé, une riche profondeur de forêt, des changements d’altitude dramatiques, une faible profondeur de champ lors des plans rapprochés et des silhouettes nettes et lisibles. Le monde doit donner l’impression d’un environnement physique miniature de jeu voxel où la gravité, les pentes, l’élan et les collisions se comportent de manière cohérente."

duration: "30 seconds"

aspect_ratio: "16:9"

character_modeling:
chicken:
base: "Small round voxel chicken built entirely from chunky cubic blocks, with a compact rounded body created from visible voxel clusters."
features: "White and cream block-plumage, blocky red voxel comb, orange cubic beak, short cube legs, tiny yellow voxel feet, and simple dark cube eyes."
personality: "Sweet, curious, confused by the mysterious egg, then determined and slightly panicked when the egg begins rolling."
physics: "The chicken has believable weight for its small size. Feet remain planted on terrain when standing, body shifts slightly when pushing, and running produces discrete stepped footfalls with visible weight transfer."
movement: "All movement uses stepped voxel animation. The chicken wakes, walks, inspects the egg, taps it, pushes it, leans harder into it, reacts when it begins moving, then runs downhill after it."
continuity: "Exact same chicken design, proportions, colors, facial features, comb, beak, feet, and voxel construction throughout the entire video."
golden_egg:
base: "Huge golden voxel egg significantly larger than the chicken, constructed from dense cubic golden and pale-yellow blocks."
proportions: "Egg is approximately three times the chicken's height and wide enough that the chicken cannot lift it."
surface: "Clearly egg-shaped through stepped voxel geometry while still visibly constructed from cubic blocks. Slightly uneven handmade voxel surface."
physics: "The egg is heavy and stationary on flat or gently sloped ground until the chicken applies enough force. Once pushed beyond its balance point on the hillside, gravity causes it to roll naturally downhill. It accelerates gradually with the slope, maintains momentum on the descending terrain, slows slightly when reaching flatter ground, then continues forward until the final stopping point."
continuity: "The egg must remain the same size, shape, color, mass, and orientation throughout the sequence."
critical_behavior: "The egg never floats, teleports, bounces unrealistically, changes direction without an obstacle, rolls uphill, or moves without physical cause."
baby_chicken:
base: "Tiny adorable voxel chick emerging from inside the cracked golden egg."
features: "Small pale-yellow cubic body, tiny orange beak, tiny dark cube eyes, miniature orange feet, soft rounded voxel proportions."
personality: "Curious, innocent, sleepy, and immediately adorable."
movement: "Initially remains curled inside the egg, then slowly pokes its head through the crack and looks up at the larger chicken."
environment_modeling:
hillside_coop:
base: "Small wooden voxel chicken coop positioned clearly on the upper portion of a grassy hillside."
features: "Wood-plank walls built from stacked cubes, square doorway, small straw nest, simple roof, short fence sections, scattered grass blocks."
terrain: "The coop sits on a visibly elevated grassy slope. The ground immediately outside the doorway descends continuously downhill."
spatial_logic: "The coop is the highest point of the sequence. The hill slopes downward away from the coop in one clear direction, creating the natural path for the egg to roll."
downhill_meadow:
base: "Open grassy voxel hillside directly below the coop."
features: "Layered grass-and-dirt blocks, small flowers, scattered stones, short grass clusters, gentle uneven terrain."
spatial_logic: "The meadow forms a continuous downhill slope. There are no invisible barriers or unexplained changes in elevation."
forest_path:
base: "A mostly straight flatter voxel path continuing from the bottom of the grassy hill."
features: "Dense blocky trees on both sides, dark green cubic foliage, thick voxel trunks, bushes, stones, patches of grass."
spatial_logic: "The forest exists along both sides of the path but does not block the egg's route. The path runs straight forward and gradually narrows toward the river edge."
river:
base: "Deep wide voxel river located beyond the end of the forest path."
features: "Dark blue layered cubic water, steep blocky riverbanks, visible depth below the path, scattered rocks along the water."
spatial_logic: "The river lies significantly below the path at the final edge, creating a dangerous drop. The egg approaches the edge directly and would fall into the river if the chicken does not stop it."
final_edge:
base: "A clear blocky cliff edge where the straight forest path ends above the deep river."
features: "Grass blocks ending abruptly, a few exposed dirt and stone blocks, visible water far below."
physics: "The egg continues rolling toward the edge but is physically stopped by the chicken before its center of mass crosses the cliff boundary."

cinematic_storyboard:
00_04_waking_and_discovery:
camera: "Interior medium close-up inside the elevated chicken coop. Begin focused on the chicken sleeping in its straw nest, then gently track toward the square doorway."
action: "The chicken wakes with two slow stepped movements. It blinks, stretches slightly, climbs out of the nest, and waddles toward the doorway. As it steps outside, it suddenly stops."
reveal: "Camera moves behind the chicken and reveals a gigantic golden voxel egg sitting several steps away on the grassy hillside."
performance: "The chicken tilts its head left, then right, clearly confused."
lighting: "Soft golden sunrise entering from the doorway, brighter light outside."
audio: "Quiet morning ambience, tiny footsteps, distant birds, subtle magical tone when the golden egg is revealed."
04_08_inspection:
camera: "Low three-quarter angle showing both the chicken and giant egg on the sloping terrain."
action: "The chicken slowly walks around the egg, looking up at it. It approaches the lower side of the egg and gently taps it with one wing."
reaction: "The egg does not move. The chicken waits, blinks, then taps it again."
physical_detail: "The chicken's feet remain firmly planted on the hillside. The egg stays completely stationary."
performance: "The chicken becomes more curious and places both wings against the egg."
audio: "Soft tap sounds against the hard voxel shell, quiet morning ambience."
08_12_the_push:
camera: "Side profile at ground level, clearly showing the downhill direction of the grassy hill."
action: "The chicken leans forward and pushes the egg with its body. At first the egg barely moves. The chicken slides its feet backward slightly under pressure, then pushes harder."
physics: "The egg shifts only a small amount uphill against its own inertia, then reaches the balance point where the downhill slope takes over."
reaction: "The chicken suddenly loses resistance as the egg begins rolling away."
audio: "Low blocky friction sound, tiny dirt compression sounds, then a sudden deep rolling impact as the egg starts moving."
12_16_rolling_downhill:
camera: "Dynamic tracking shot from behind and slightly above the egg, following its path down the grassy slope."
action: "The egg rolls naturally downhill, rotating around its long axis while following the existing slope. It accelerates gradually as the terrain steepens."
chicken_action: "The chicken freezes for one beat, realizes what happened, then immediately runs after it."
physical_detail: "The egg remains in contact with the terrain throughout the descent. Grass blocks and tiny voxel dirt particles react underneath it."
audio: "Growing rolling rumble, grass impacts, rapid chicken footsteps."
16_21_the_forest_path:
camera: "Low side-tracking shot parallel to the egg's route, then transition to a forward-facing shot."
action: "The hill naturally levels out into a straight dirt-and-grass voxel path. The egg continues rolling forward using the momentum gained from the slope."
environment: "Dense blocky forest lines both sides of the path. Trees remain stationary while the egg rolls down the center."
chicken_action: "The chicken runs after the egg, using short fast stepped movements, occasionally jumping over small raised blocks in the path."
physics: "As the slope becomes flatter, the egg gradually loses speed from friction but continues rolling forward rather than abruptly stopping."
lighting: "Sunlight filters through cubic tree canopies, creating alternating warm light and shadow."
audio: "Rolling egg rhythm, rapid

ja.content:
ボクセルアートスタイル、3Dの立方体ブロック構成、MagicaVoxel風の美学。詳細な立方体ジオメトリ、個々のボクセル単位が見える、Minecraftに着想を得たスタイライズされたプロポーション、物理的に説得力のあるオブジェクト相互作用、一貫した地形構築を備えた、シネマティックなゲームカットシーン表現。すべてのキャラクター、オブジェクト、植物、岩、建物、環境要素は、完全に離散的な立方体ブロックのみで構成されている。

final_edge:
base: "A clear blocky cliff edge where the straight forest path ends above the deep river."
features: "Grass blocks ending abruptly, a few exposed dirt and stone blocks, visible water far below."
physics: "The egg continues rolling toward the edge but is physically stopped by the chicken before its center of mass crosses the cliff boundary."

cinematic_storyboard:
00_04_waking_and_discovery:
camera: "Interior medium close-up inside the elevated chicken coop. Begin focused on the chicken sleeping in its straw nest, then gently track toward the square doorway."
action: "The chicken wakes with two slow stepped movements. It blinks, stretches slightly, climbs out of the nest, and waddles toward the doorway. As it steps outside, it suddenly stops."
reveal: "Camera moves behind the chicken and reveals a gigantic golden voxel egg sitting several steps away on the grassy hillside."
performance: "The chicken tilts its head left, then right, clearly confused."
lighting: "Soft golden sunrise entering from the doorway, brighter light outside."
audio: "Quiet morning ambience, tiny footsteps, distant birds, subtle magical tone when the golden egg is revealed."
04_08_inspection:
camera: "Low three-quarter angle showing both the chicken and giant egg on the sloping terrain."
action: "The chicken slowly walks around the egg, looking up at it. It approaches the lower side of the egg and gently taps it with one wing."
reaction: "The egg does not move. The chicken waits, blinks, then taps it again."
physical_detail: "The chicken's feet remain firmly planted on the hillside. The egg stays completely stationary."
performance: "The chicken becomes more curious and places both wings against the egg."
audio: "Soft tap sounds against the hard voxel shell, quiet morning ambience."
08_12_the_push:
camera: "Side profile at ground level, clearly showing the downhill direction of the grassy hill."
action: "The chicken leans forward and pushes the egg with its body. At first the egg barely moves. The chicken slides its feet backward slightly under pressure, then pushes harder."
physics: "The egg shifts only a small amount uphill against its own inertia, then reaches the balance point where the downhill slope takes over."
reaction: "The chicken suddenly loses resistance as the egg begins rolling away."
audio: "Low blocky friction sound, tiny dirt compression sounds, then a sudden deep rolling impact as the egg starts moving."
12_16_rolling_downhill:
camera: "Dynamic tracking shot from behind and slightly above the egg, following its path down the grassy slope."
action: "The egg rolls naturally downhill, rotating around its long axis while following the existing slope. It accelerates gradually as the terrain steepens."
chicken_action: "The chicken freezes for one beat, realizes what happened, then immediately runs after it."
physical_detail: "The egg remains in contact with the terrain throughout the descent. Grass blocks and tiny voxel dirt particles react underneath it."
audio: "Growing rolling rumble, grass impacts, rapid chicken footsteps."
16_21_the_forest_path:
camera: "Low side-tracking shot parallel to the egg's route, then transition to a forward-facing shot."
action: "The hill naturally levels out into a straight dirt-and-grass voxel path. The egg continues rolling forward using the momentum gained from the slope."
environment: "Dense blocky forest lines both sides of the path. Trees remain stationary while the egg rolls down the center."
chicken_action: "The chicken runs after the egg, using short fast stepped movements, occasionally jumping over small raised blocks in the path."
physics: "As the slope becomes flatter, the egg gradually loses speed from friction but continues rolling forward rather than abruptly stopping."
lighting: "Sunlight filters through cubic tree canopies, creating alternating warm light and shadow."
audio: "Rolling egg rhythm, rapid footsteps, leaves and grass movement."
